desc:
This game is meant to be a fun ro-racing league game with crazy crashes and good handling overall. 

NOTE: More tracks will be added to league mode and competitive mode!

"Shift+P" for free cam.
"E" for ERS activation.
"Q" for DRS activation under certain conditions.

PS5 Controls:

ERS: Square
DRS: Triangle
Pace: Circle

Xbox Controls:

ERS: X
DRS: Y
Pace: B

If you want to host your own races but don't have the admin gui, make a private server.

This game is inspired by games made by Bubble studios.
